question: 14 men can complete a work in 15 days. If 21 men are employed, then in how many days will they complete the same work?
solution:
Given:

14 men can complete a work in 15 days

Concept used:

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Here,

M1 = Men at the 1st case

D1 = Time at the 1st case

M2 = Men at the 2nd case

D2 = Time at the 2nd case 

Calculation:

According to the concept,

M1 = 14

D1 = 15

M2 = 21

Let D2 be x

So,

14 × 15 = 21 × x

⇒ 210 = 21x

⇒ x = 210/21

⇒ x = 10

So, D2 = 10 days

**∴ They will complete the same work in 10 days.**
